item.title: Labels Made Easy
item.description: I work as a systems engineer at a big tech company, but back home my family is in the bakery business. In my spare time, I like to build things to help make the bakery more efficient and organized. By far, my biggest bakery project has been an order tracking system I like to call OrderMonger, but that’s a story for a different day. Today, I want to talk about the inventory labeling system I built from scratch in less than two weeks.

item.title: ESXi Cluster - Part 1
item.description:
A few months ago a friend of mine was offloading some old(er) 2U Supermicro Servers. I decided to grab a couple and turn them into a 2-node ESXi cluster!

Part 1 of this series will focus on specs, cabling, and IPMI configuration.

item.description: For only $4 I couldn’t pass up the opportunity to tinker with the new(ish) Raspberry Pi Pico!

item.title: About Me
item.description: Hey, I’m John! I enjoy everything from guitar and Lego to 3D printing, networking, and infrastructure. I studied computer science and started working in tech in 2018, but I’ve been tinkering for as long as I can remember! Reach out to me at jp[at]organizedchaos.tech
